Wife’s Refusal of Physical Relationship Can Amount to Mental Cruelty: Bombay High Court on Divorce

The Bombay High Court has upheld a divorce decree after finding that the wife’s refusal to have physical relations with her husband, allegations of extra-marital affairs, public humiliation and other conduct, when considered cumulatively and supported by evidence, amounted to men…

Case Analysis 👉🏻 🔗 https://lnkd.in/dn55V5Tc
comment: An important aspect is that courts assess matrimonial cruelty cumulatively, but evidence quality remains critical. Each allegation must be examined in context, not in isolation or based on assumptions.
